data.summary: Senior Business Analyst with 10+ years of experience delivering enterprise and regulatory and digital transformation initiatives across Capital Markets, Banking, Transportation, and E-Commerce domains. Expertise in requirements elicitation, stakeholder management, business process analysis, Agile delivery, and end-to-end SDLC for large-scale enterprise applications. Skilled in banking microservices, API integrations, data mapping, SQL-based data validation, UAT management, and ISO 20022 regulatory initiatives. Proven track record of leading requirement analysis, stakeholder collaboration, and solution design for enterprise banking applications involving ISO 20022, APIs, microservices, SQL validation, and Agile delivery.

raw_sections.experience:
PROFESSIONAL EXPERIENCE
Mphasis – Senior Software Engineer| Functional Role : Senior Business Analyst Client: Charles Schwab | Domain: Capital Markets- Equity Compensation & Employee Stock Plans | Dec 2024 – June 2026
Business Analysis & Requirements ●
Led end-to-end requirement elicitation for banking microservices aligned with ISO 20022 regulatory standards, ensuring compliance and interoperability
Defined and documented functional and non-functional requirements (FRD/NFR) through stakeholder workshops with business users, Product Owners, and technical teams.
Translated complex business needs into clear user stories, acceptance criteria, and process flows, and service-level requirements for microservices and API-based systems.
● Collaborated with Solution Architects and backend engineering teams to define business capabilities, functional scope,
and service boundaries for microservices-based architecture.
Acted as the single point of contact between business backend engineering, and QA teams for requirement clarification and delivery alignment.
Technical Analysis & Data Validation ● Performed data mapping and integration analysis across systems to ensure accurate data flow between upstream and
downstream applications.
Validated business rules and backend data using SQL queries, ensuring correctness of calculations, mappings, and system outputs.
Collaborated with Data Analysts and engineers to validate data transformations, integration logic, and reporting outputs.
Performed root cause analysis (RCA) for data and system discrepancies, coordinating resolution with development and integration teams. UAT, Release & Agile Delivery
Owned end-to-end UAT, including scenario review, defect triage , validation , and securing business sign-off before
release ● Coordinated with onshore stakeholders and cross-functional Agile teams during UAT and release phases to ensure
smooth deployment and approvals.
Produced Agile sprint reports and delivery metrics, including velocity tracking, defect status, and progress dashboards for stakeholder visibility.
Scrum Master ● ● Acted as the direct client-facing representative for all team performance metrics.
Led team management and operational delivery for a 15-member team.
Capgemini – Senior Consultant| Functional Role: Business Analyst & Scrum Master Client: Wabtec, Dominos | Domains: Transport, E-Commerce | Aug 2021 – Dec 2024
Conducted business requirement elicitation through stakeholder interviews, workshops, and brainstorming sessions to capture, analyze, and document requirements.
Prepared and maintained Business Requirement Documents (BRD), Functional Requirement Documents (FRD), user stories, and acceptance criteria aligned with Agile DoR/DoD standards.
Performed gap analysis and impact analysis for change requests and production issues to assess business and system dependencies.
Performed As-Is and To-Be process analysis to support business process improvements. ● Collaborated with Product Owners to refine and prioritize backlog items, reduce requirement gaps, and improve delivery efficiency.
Designed and executed UAT test cases, validated defects against requirements, and ensured successful release sign-off. ● Coordinated release management activities including ServiceNow change requests, approvals, and deployment readiness with release teams.
Worked in a cross-functional Agile environment, coordinating between business stakeholders, development teams, QA, and release management teams.
Worked in a SAFe Agile environment, supporting collaboration across Agile Release Trains (ARTs) and multiple Scrum teams.
Acted as Scrum Master in a SAFe Agile environment, facilitating PI Planning support, sprint planning, daily stand-ups, sprint reviews, retrospectives, and Agile delivery for two Scrum teams (8 and 6 members).
Generated and maintained Agile project reports including sprint status dashboards, defect metrics, velocity tracking, and quarterly delivery reports to support project governance, transparency, and stakeholder reporting.
Additional Delivery Responsibilities
Collaborated with Project Managers on capacity planning, resource allocation, and delivery tracking to ensure smooth execution.
Managed monthly project billing activities, invoice validation, and coordination with finance teams for billing approvals.
Assisted in preparation and maintenance of Statements of Work (SOWs) and project governance documentation. ● Managed end-to-end resource lifecycle operations, including onboarding, offboarding, and utilization tracking. ● Acted as the primary coordination point between client, PM, and delivery teams for status reporting and issue resolution.
Career Break | Maternity Break | Jan 2017- Aug 2021 HCL Technologies- Senior Software Engineer |Functional Role: Team Lead & Scrum Master
Client: Citi | Domain: Capital Markets (Equity Trading and Risk Management) | Aug 2011 – Jan 2017
Business Analysis & Stakeholder Collaboration
Acted as the primary point of contact for business users, coordinating with development, infrastructure, and database teams to investigate, troubleshoot, and resolve production issues.
Served as the Subject Matter Expert (SME) for EQRMS, providing functional and technical guidance to team members and acting as the escalation point for complex production issues.
Collaborated with Product Owners to remove impediments and improve delivery predictability for the team. ● Facilitated Agile Scrum ceremonies (Daily Stand-ups, Sprint Planning, Sprint Reviews, and Retrospectives) and tracked sprint progress as the Scrum Master.
Technical Analysis & Problem Resolution ● Performed root cause analysis of production incidents using SQL queries and log analysis to identify underlying
issues.
Analyzed batch processing failures, validated backend data using SQL, and coordinated defect fixes with development teams.
Prepared RCA documentation and operational knowledge base articles, and identified recurring production issues to recommend process improvements that enhanced application stability and operational efficiency.
Operations & Production Support ● Supported business-critical Equity Risk Management operations by providing production support for the global Equity Risk Management System (EQRMS), ensuring application stability and timely resolution of production incidents.
Monitored and managed global batch job executions, proactively identifying and resolving failures to minimize business impact.
Managed day-to-day production support operations, including incident prioritization, workload distribution, shift planning, leave management, performance tracking, and SLA adherence across the team.
Leadership and Team Development ● Mentored new team members through knowledge transfer sessions, application walkthroughs, and troubleshooting
guidance.
